raw_response: {"diagnosis":"83 raw_transactions rows are in EUR, but silver_transactions casts amount without converting, so EUR amounts are summed as USD in every gold table. raw_fx_rates has exactly one rate per currency (EUR 1.25, USD 1.0), so the conversion is unambiguous. I convert amount to USD in silver_transactions and leave the gold steps unchanged.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, r.customer_id, CAST(r.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(ROUND(r.amount * f.rate_to_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r LEFT JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON f.currency = r.currency WHERE r.status = 'POSTED'"}}
